description: Domain layer and data layer: all models, config loader, asset loaders, preferences store, retrieval logic, accumulator, prompt builder, parser, and validators. This is pure Dart with no Flutter widgets — every class is unit-testable. Depends on FEAT-001 (pubspec and folder layout must exist). Independent of FEAT-003 (ML interfaces).
steps: Create lib/domain/models.dart with all domain types. Every class uses const constructors and is immutable (final fields). Implement: enum Equipment { riceCooker, kettle, microwave, stove }; enum IngredientSource { owned, substituted, toBuy }; enum ResultKind { adapted, fallbackBase }. Class Ingredient: final String id, nameFil, nameEn; final List<String> aliases; const constructor; factory Ingredient.fromJson(Map<String,dynamic>). Class RecipeIngredient: final String ingredientId; final double qty; final String unit; final bool core; const constructor; factory fromJson. Class Recipe: final String id, nameFil, nameEn; final List<RecipeIngredient> ingredients; final Set<Equipment> equipment; final List<String> steps; final int minutes, servings; const constructor; factory fromJson (equipment field is List<String> in JSON, convert via Equipment.values.byName). Class Preferences: final Set<Equipment> equipment; final int extraBudgetPesos; const constructor. Class AdaptRequest: final Recipe base; final Set<String> ownedIds; final Preferences prefs; const constructor. Class AdaptedIngredient: final String ingredientId, qtyText; final IngredientSource source; final String? replacesId; const constructor. Class AdaptedRecipe: final String name, notes; final int minutes; final List<AdaptedIngredient> ingredients; final List<String> steps; const constructor. Class RecipeResult: final ResultKind kind; final Recipe base; final AdaptedRecipe? adapted; final int estimatedExtraPesos; final List<String> flags; const constructor. Note: flags values are the strings 'overBudget', 'lowMatch', 'unpricedItem'.

Create lib/core/config_loader.dart. Class AppConfig with typed fields matching assets/config/app_config.json exactly: ScanConfig scan (intervalMs, windowSize, minHits, minConfidence, photoMinConfidence, topK), RetrievalConfig retrieval (limit, minOwnedCoreRatio), LlmConfig llm (temperature, topP, maxTokens, contextSize, timeoutSeconds, maxRetries), List<int> budgetPresets, int defaultBudget. Each sub-config is its own class with const constructor and fromJson. AppConfig.fromJson parses the root map. Provide a static Future<AppConfig> load() that calls rootBundle.loadString('assets/config/app_config.json') and decodes it.

Create lib/data/asset_loaders.dart. Class AppBundle: final List<Ingredient> ingredients; final List<Recipe> recipes; final Map<String,int> prices (keyed by ingredientId); final String priceDate; const constructor. Static Future<AppBundle> load() uses rootBundle to load all three JSON files concurrently with Future.wait, then parses them: ingredients from List, recipes from List (using Recipe.fromJson), prices from entries array ({ingredientId, pesos}), priceDate from collectedOn field.

Create lib/data/preferences_store.dart. Class PreferencesStore: Future<Preferences> load() reads keys 'equipment' (List<String>, default ['riceCooker']) and 'budget' (int, default 30) from SharedPreferences, returns Preferences. Future<void> save(Preferences p) writes both keys. Equipment values serialized as their enum name strings.

Create lib/domain/retrieval.dart. Implement the pure function: List<RecipeResult> retrieve(List<Recipe> recipes, Map<String,int> prices, Set<String> ownedIds, Preferences prefs, {int limit = 3}). Follow PRD 17.7 exactly: (1) filter to recipes whose equipment set intersects prefs.equipment; (2) for each compute ownedCoreRatio = owned core count / total core count (0.0 if no core ingredients), missingCost = sum of prices[id] for missing ingredients (0 if absent from price table — but set unpricedItem flag if any missing core ingredient has no price entry), overBudget flag when missingCost > prefs.extraBudgetPesos, lowMatch flag when ownedCoreRatio < retrieval minOwnedCoreRatio (use 0.5 as hardcoded default since config is loaded separately — accept it as a parameter: double minOwnedCoreRatio = 0.5); (3) eligible = !overBudget && !lowMatch; (4) sort eligible: ownedCoreRatio desc, missingCost asc, minutes asc; (5) fill with non-eligible (same sort) flagging each; (6) return at most limit results. Never throw on empty input. Return empty list if no equipment match.

Create lib/domain/accumulator.dart. Pure Dart class Accumulator. Constructor takes ScanConfig (or explicit windowSize, minHits, minConfidence int/double parameters — use explicit params to avoid coupling). Fields: final int windowSize, minHits; final double minConfidence; final List<List<Prediction>> _window (Prediction is from ml/detector.dart — use a local typedef or import; to avoid circular dependency define Accumulator to take Map<String,double> frames instead of List<Prediction> — a Map from ingredientId to confidence for that frame). Method void addFrame(Map<String,double> framePredictions): add to window, drop oldest if over windowSize. Getter Set<String> get detected: for each ingredientId that appears across window frames, count hits (frames where it appears) and compute average confidence across those frames; return ids where hitCount >= minHits AND avgConfidence >= minConfidence. Once an id is detected it stays until reset() is called (implement by tracking a Set<String> _permanentlyDetected that is union of detected at each addFrame call — ids are added but never removed until reset). Method void reset() clears both _window and _permanentlyDetected.

Create lib/domain/prompt_builder.dart. Pure function String buildPrompt(AdaptRequest req, List<Ingredient> vocab) that builds the tagged-line prompt described in PRD 17.8. System message first, then user message with: base recipe name and time, base ingredients (one per line: id, qty unit, core/optional), numbered base steps, 'USER HAS: id1, id2, ...', 'EQUIPMENT: name1, name2', then the rules and format block. The tagged output format to include in the prompt is exactly as in PRD 17.8: NAME, TIME, INGREDIENTS block with owned/sub/buy lines, STEPS block, NOTES, END.

Create lib/domain/parser.dart. Function ParseResult parseResponse(String raw, List<String> ingredientVocab) returning a class ParseResult { final AdaptedRecipe? recipe; final List<String> errors; }. Strip markdown fences (``` lines). Match markers NAME, TIME, INGREDIENTS, STEPS, NOTES, END case-insensitively with optional colon or dash after marker. Ignore blank lines. Parse ingredient lines starting with '- owned |', '- sub |', '- buy |' (case-insensitive, pipe-separated: source | qtyText | ingredientId [| replaces ingredientId]). Parse STEPS as numbered lines '1. text'. Return ParseResult with recipe=null and populated errors list on any parse failure.

Create lib/domain/validators.dart. Function List<String> validate(AdaptedRecipe recipe, AdaptRequest req, Map<String,int> prices, List<String> vocab) implementing all 8 validators V1–V8 per PRD 17.8. Collect all errors and return them all (do not short-circuit). V1: NAME present (non-empty), >=1 ingredient, >=1 step, END reached (parser guarantees this — check recipe.steps.isNotEmpty && recipe.ingredients.isNotEmpty && recipe.name.isNotEmpty). V2: every ingredient id in vocab (set lookup). V3: every ingredient with source==owned has its ingredientId in req.ownedIds. V4: every ingredient with source==toBuy has its ingredientId absent from req.ownedIds; if its id is not in prices, do NOT add an error — instead return separately as a list of unpricedIds (change signature to ValidationResult class with List<String> errors and List<String> unpricedIds). V5: every ingredient with source==substituted has replacesId != null, replacesId exists in base recipe ingredients, and ingredientId is in req.ownedIds. V6: scan recipe.steps for equipment keywords; reject any step mentioning oven/air fryer/grill/blender (always), and reject any step mentioning equipment outside req.prefs.equipment (use word-boundary matching: check for 'rice cooker'/'ricecooker' for Equipment.riceCooker, 'kettle' for kettle, 'microwave' for microwave, 'stove'/'pan'/'frying pan' for stove). V7: every core ingredient in base recipe appears in adapted ingredients as owned, sub, or buy. V8: recipe.minutes is an integer between 1 and 180 inclusive.

Create test/retrieval_test.dart with these test cases: exact-match recipe (owns all core ingredients) ranks first; recipe requiring equipment not in prefs is excluded from results entirely; over-budget recipe is flagged overBudget and ranked after eligible recipes; ties resolve by ownedCoreRatio desc then missingCost asc then minutes asc; empty ownedIds returns results without throwing (flags lowMatch or overBudget appropriately); same input always produces same output (deterministic). Use the same 3 recipes from assets/data/recipes.json as test data (hardcode the Recipe objects in the test).

Create test/accumulator_test.dart with these test cases: flicker case — ingredient appears in fewer than minHits frames, should NOT appear in detected; threshold case — ingredient appears in minHits+ frames but average confidence below minConfidence, should NOT appear in detected; happy path — ingredient appears in minHits+ frames with avg confidence >= minConfidence, appears in detected and stays after subsequent frames where it's absent; reset case — after reset(), detected is empty and previously detected ids are gone.

Create test/validators_test.dart with at least two test cases per validator V1–V8: one that passes and one that catches the specific violation. Use a minimal AdaptRequest with one owned ingredient and one base Recipe.

Create tool/validate_data.dart (standalone script AND importable-as-library). Checks: no recipe references an ingredient id missing from ingredients.json; every recipe has at least one core ingredient; every recipe has non-empty equipment list and non-empty steps list; every core ingredient in every recipe has an entry in prices.json; if assets/models/labels.txt exists, every id in it is present in ingredients.json. The file must be runnable as 'dart run tool/validate_data.dart' and also importable for test/validate_data_test.dart.
Create test/validate_data_test.dart that imports tool/validate_data.dart and runs all five checks against the actual sample JSON files as unit tests.
acceptance_criteria: lib/domain/models.dart defines all 10 types (3 enums + 7 classes) with const constructors and fromJson where required
lib/core/config_loader.dart loads and parses assets/config/app_config.json into typed AppConfig
lib/data/asset_loaders.dart loads all three JSON asset files into AppBundle
lib/data/preferences_store.dart persists and loads Equipment set and budget via shared_preferences
lib/domain/retrieval.dart implements all 6 steps of PRD 17.7 exactly
lib/domain/accumulator.dart passes all three test cases (flicker, threshold, reset)
lib/domain/prompt_builder.dart produces the tagged-line prompt format from PRD 17.8
lib/domain/parser.dart parses valid tagged-line responses and returns error lists for malformed ones
lib/domain/validators.dart implements all V1–V8 validators and collects all errors
test/validators_test.dart passes all V1–V8 valid+invalid cases
test/validate_data_test.dart passes all 5 data integrity checks
